correctness.rationale: With j dissenting leaves on K_(1,m), leaf conversion rate equals j while first hub flip hazard is (j/m)^q. Competing exponential clocks yield exactly product_{j=k+1}^m [1+j^(q-1)/m^q]^-1 for Pr(K_m<=k), with P_m the k=0 product. Each j<m factor strictly increases in q; q=1 gives (m/(m+1))^m<1/2; q=2 gives >1/2 (separately m=2), hence unique q_m in (1,2), q_2=log_2(3). For fixed q>0, logarithms reduce to improper Riemann sum integral_x^1 u^(q-1)du=(1-x^q)/q and uniform log remainder since max_j t_j->0; this yields CDF exp(-(1-x^q)/q), atom e^(-1/q) at zero and q_m->1/log2. These are first-reversal statistics, not unrestricted fixation equality. Actual verify.py inspected, its finite rational recurrences are only supporting tests.
